training_window.cohort: all available labelled league maps in canonical E347 dataset, duration > 60*t
training_window.stack: all available variant-A joined rows; see per-minute actual timestamp bounds

feature_definitions.nw_thousands: Radiant NW lead at minute t divided by 1000 (gold in thousands).
feature_definitions.kill_diff: Radiant cumulative kills at index t minus Dire cumulative kills at index t; raw counts.
feature_definitions.kill_total: Radiant plus Dire cumulative kills at index t; raw counts.
feature_definitions.logit_all: logit of binary Radiant probability from served All draft verdict.
feature_definitions.logit_late: logit of binary Radiant probability from served Late draft verdict.
feature_definitions.logit_early_win: logit of binary Radiant probability from served Early Win draft verdict.
feature_definitions.logit_enw_rad: logit(P_Radiant/(P_Radiant+P_Dire)) from Early NW; conditional direction, excludes no-marker.
feature_definitions.logit_head: logit of head Radiant map-win probability.
feature_definitions.logit_elo: logit of prematch variant-A Radiant probability; live formula 1/(1+10**((dire_rating-radiant_rating)/400)).

inference: p=sigmoid(((features-mean)/scale) dot coef + intercept); head first, then stack
limitations: Retrospective static September pub draft bundles, not forward-time pub training or prospective serving validation.
Canonical hero intersection excludes some short maps; 10-minute population is not all maps alive at minute 10.
Variant-A replay stops before 2026-09-21; missing ELO is kept missing. Stack coverage differs from head coverage.
F vs A6 changes state/draft features, ELO variant (A vs K24), and stack training population (league vs master). This is not an isolated feature ablation.

Evaluation stack uses prior-month OOS heads (April onward), with current test-series purge propagated to prior heads. Serving stack uses all available league rows with final-head fitted predictions, as requested; this differs from OOS evaluation training.
Live adapters round probabilities to six decimals; artifact/fixture use unrounded offline probabilities. Neither local defaults nor historical export proves current production configuration.
No SSH, production, bets, Telegram, price, deploy, profitability or live calibration check. No commits or deletions.
